name: Statico
about: A static site generator I wrote in Rust. One binary, no Node: plain HTML and markdown in, fast static sites out. It builds this site.

name: Playground
about: Statico compiled to WebAssembly: edit a site and watch it rebuild, with nothing installed and nothing sent anywhere.

name: adwebdev
about: This site: a small operating system in the browser, built with Statico. Plain HTML and CSS and one script, no frameworks.

name: berth
about: Docker and Linux virtual machines on Apple Silicon, straight onto Virtualization.framework. A free take on OrbStack.
